nl: Change the port of the orders service in etc/systemd/system/orders.service from 8080 to 9000.

etc/systemd/system/orders.service.text:
[Unit]
Description=Orders service
After=network.target

[Service]
User=orders
ExecStart=/opt/orders/bin/orders --port 9000
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('etc/systemd/system/orders.service'); t = p.read_text()
assert t.count('--port 8080') == 1
p.write_text(t.replace('--port 8080', '--port 9000'))
EOF
